title: LFO_tabosc2~
description: `LFO_tabosc2~` is a low-frequency wavetable oscillator described as a two-point interpolation version of `tabosc4~`, with frequency specified in hertz. Its first argument names the array and its second sets the frequency; the array can also be changed with a `set array-name` message, and the initial phase is in the range 0 to 1.
